text.forecast: Weather satellites see a regional dust storm coming. The sky will darken soon.
text.start: A regional dust storm has darkened the sky.
text.effect: Solar power may drop by about 40 to 65% for several sols.
text.engineers: Charge the batteries, lower non-essential power such as lab and greenhouse lights, and delay EVAs.

name: Global dust storm
teaches: Why the Opportunity rover was lost

text.forecast: A global dust storm is spreading around the planet. Expect almost no sunlight for more than a week.
text.start: A global dust storm has wrapped the whole planet in dust.
text.effect: Solar power may drop by 80 to 90% for 8 to 12 sols.
text.engineers: Keep only air, heat and water running. Every kilowatt-hour in the battery matters.

text.forecast: Orbit calculations show the crater rim will block the Sun soon.
text.start: The base has entered a shadow period. Very little sunlight reaches the panels.
text.effect: Solar power will be 0 to 25% of normal for 2 to 4 days.
text.engineers: Fill the batteries, switch off non-essential systems, and protect heating and life support.

text.forecast: Space weather forecast: a solar flare may send a burst of radiation toward the base.
text.start: A solar particle event is hitting the base with high-energy protons.
text.effect: Radiation dose will jump far above normal while it lasts.
text.engineers: Move the crew into the storm shelter and cancel all spacewalks.

text.start: A fault in the oxygen generator cut its output to 30%.
text.effect: The base makes much less oxygen until it is repaired.
text.engineers: Repair it quickly. An Engineer on Maintenance fixes it in one day.

text.start: A clogged filter dropped the water recycler to 20% of normal.
text.effect: Most used water is lost until the recycler is repaired.
text.engineers: Repair the recycler before the water tanks run low.

text.start: Some battery cells failed. The battery can now hold 25% less energy.
text.effect: Less energy is stored for the night.
text.engineers: Repair the battery bank and reduce night-time power use.

text.start: A tiny meteorite cracked part of the solar array.
text.effect: Solar output dropped by 20% until the panels are repaired.
text.engineers: Repair the solar array. Without air, nothing slows meteorites down.

text.start: A plant disease is spreading in the greenhouse.
text.effect: Greenhouse food production is halved for 4 days.
text.engineers: Keep packaged food as a backup. Never rely on just one food source.

text.start: A crew member is sick and must stay in bed.
text.effect: They still eat, drink and breathe, but cannot work for 2 days.
text.engineers: Move other crew to the most important jobs.

text.forecast: A cargo lander from Earth is on its way. The landing pad must be clear of dust storms.
text.start: The resupply lander touched down safely.
text.effect: +70,000 kcal of food and +20 build points.
text.engineers: Plan around deliveries, but never depend on them completely.
